summary_md: **Arnaud Mercier - #Entrepreneur #Versailles ([@arnaudmercier](https://x.com/arnaudmercier/status/2115720851811098781))** shares **Agent-Conditioned Routing** ([arXiv 2610.37375](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.37375v1)), which uses the conditional routing capacity of a frozen sparse MoE to produce genuinely diverse reasoning paths from one prompt without assigned roles or prescribed methods.

referenced_urls.title: Agent-Conditioned Routing:Diverse Reasoning Paths Within One Frozen Model

relevance: Diversity of reasoning from a single MoE model, relevant to local MoE reasoners.

media.description: Figure from the paper: chart comparing agent-conditioned routing with temperature sampling.
